name: aggregate_query
description: Run a SOQL-style aggregate (COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX) over one object with optional GROUP BY and filter (GET /services/data/v62.0/query?q=SELECT+COUNT(Id)+FROM+X+GROUP+BY+Y).

sobject.description: API name of the object to aggregate, e.g. sales_opportunities or service_cases.

function.description: Aggregate function: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN or MAX. Defaults to COUNT.

field.description: Field the aggregate applies to. Required for everything except COUNT.

group_by.description: Field to group the results by.

where_field.description: Field for an optional equality filter.

group_by_function.description: Optional SOQL date bucket applied to group_by: CALENDAR_MONTH, CALENDAR_YEAR or DAY_ONLY.

limit.description: Maximum number of grouped rows to return (default 200).
